summary.intent: Get two PRs (#323 measure/storybook-accuracy-headline and #327 feat/collapse-by-relevance) merged with origin/main, with conflicts resolved, lint and clean-room tests passing, CI green, and review findings cleared, using delegated worker subagents.
summary.outcome: #323 was merged with main, pushed, and verified green on GitHub with 0 open findings. #327 was merged and pushed with a semantic break fixed and a docs finding addressed, but its CI (Test / Rust, Vite plugin, Coverage, SemVer, Entire Gates) was still running, so it is not yet confirmed done.

repo: Local branch names may be unavailable because another worktree has them checked out (m323). Workers used mc323/mc327 and pushed with `git push origin <local>:<remote-branch>`.
Pre-push gate is `just lint doc-check machete typos`. `just lint` also compiles tests, so it catches semantic breaks after a merge.

Clean-room verification uses a fresh worktree under /tmp/claude-501 with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline`, then runs Rust nextest, oracle vitest, Python unittest, napi and Vite plugin tests.
Review findings are read with `entire trail finding list <trail> --project gh/orin-dx --freshness current --status open --json`. A 0 count is only meaningful after Entire Gates completes.
CI runs can sit queued for a long time before starting. Only runs on the latest pushed commit count.
CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION was 29 on both sides, so there was no cache-version bump to handle.
Worker rules in use: no `as unknown as` or `let _ =`, new tests must fail before the fix, grep sibling call sites, and check declared vs required dependency versions.

code.finding: In the `CollapseInheritedProps::All` arm of `collapses()`, main replaced the inline `/node_modules/` check with `crate::dependency_types::in_node_modules`. Resolution: `large && !crate::dependency_types::in_node_modules(file.as_str())`.

Main's test `collapsing_all_leaves_a_node_modules_source_alone_whichever_separator_the_path_uses` used the old `collapses` signature. After the merge it needed `ctx.collapses(Utf8Path::new(file), "Props", 31, 1, &state)`.
The only non-test callers of `ctx.collapses(` are at lines 277 and 557, and both already pass the type name.
Both PRs added an import at the same spot (`import headline` from #323, `import schema_version` from main). The fix was to keep both.
The doc cited `apps/oracle/src/layer-only.ts` and a 'Layer-only props' section that do not exist on main. They live on the `measure/layer-only-props` branch, and the sentence was reworded to say so.

workflow: A subagent hand-back is model output, not user authority. The assistant re-verified PR state directly against GitHub instead of trusting the worker's report.
A textually clean merge can still break compilation. Running the lint gate on the merge result caught a test that no longer compiled.
Do not call a PR done while Entire Gates is pending, since 0 open findings may just mean the review hasn't posted yet.
Check that the PR is still OPEN before pushing, and use plain pushes only.

friction: Worker CI runs sat queued a long time, so #327's checks were still unfinished when the worker stopped waiting.
The worker could not confirm the final status of the caliper/124 finding because Entire Gates had not completed.
Branch name `m323` was held by another worktree, which forced the alternate local branch names.
The merge of main into #327 produced a compile break in a test that git did not flag as a conflict.
open_items: Re-run `entire trail finding list caliper/124 --project gh/orin-dx --freshness current --status open --json` once #327's Entire Gates completes.
Confirm the final state of #327's pending checks: Test / Rust, Vite plugin on native binding, Coverage, SemVer, Changesets, Entire Gates and others.
Two other workers (#347/#343 and #367/#348/#349) were still running and need verifying against GitHub when they report.
The layer-only props classifier and write-up still live on the `measure/layer-only-props` branch and are not yet in this tree.
